title: E-FRC-0110: the classical color group Sigma(648) runs under a deterministic reversible rule with no random number...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0110 in the gauge arena: the classical color group Sigma(648) runs under a deterministic reversible rule with no random number: with an integer-valued plaquette action the kinetic demon rule conserves energy to the unit, reverses to the bit, and reproduces the heatbath plaquette of the same action at the coupling its demons read.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
